title: mentha × nemorosa subsp. timbalii
intro: Mentha × nemorosa subsp. timbalii, commonly known as Bergamot Mint, is a hybrid mint plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bergamot Mint include its analgesic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful for treating conditions such as headaches, muscle cramps, and joint pain. The bioactive constituents of Bergamot Mint include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
